sense: to go to see a person or place

pins.definition: To go to spend time with a person or to see a place.
To go to see a person for social reasons or a place for interest or leisure.
To go to see a place, such as a museum, landmark, or city.

situation: An elderly woman opens her front door to welcome her adult daughter who has arrived with luggage.
subject: the arrival to see someone
brief: An elderly woman stands smiling in her brightly lit doorway, holding the door wide as her daughter steps onto the welcome mat carrying a suitcase, bridging the threshold between outside and home.
prompt: An elderly woman stands smiling in her brightly lit doorway, holding the door wide as her daughter steps onto the welcome mat carrying a suitcase, bridging the threshold between outside and home. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
